0022600015.text: The Wizards (2-3, 9th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, 1 game back) host the Hornets (3-2, 1st in the Southeast and 5th in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, Washington's sixth of the season. Washington is on a two-game losing streak and is 1-1 at home, while Charlotte enters on a one-game losing streak, and the Hornets beat the Wizards 110-103 in their last meeting in Charlotte on October 26, leaving Washington trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing all four meetings in 2025-26. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery).
